## Objective
A playable page: opening `index.html` through a static server shows a canvas Snake game with score and best score, driven by the game logic API from `src/game.js` and `src/input.js`. Those modules are being implemented in parallel by another task; here they are still stubs that throw, so code only against their documented signatures and never run the game in Node.

## Interface
Consume (do not edit) `src/game.js`: `createGame`, `step`, `setDirection`, `togglePause`, `tickDelayMs`, `DEFAULT_COLS`, `DEFAULT_ROWS`, and the `GameState` shape. Consume `src/input.js`: `keyToAction(key)` returning `{ type: 'direction', direction }`, `{ type: 'pause' }`, `{ type: 'restart' }` or `null`.

Replace the stub `src/render.js` keeping its signature: `export function render(ctx, state, cellSize)`. It must not import any module and must not read `ctx.canvas`; it derives the board size from `state.cols * cellSize` and `state.rows * cellSize`. Allowed context API only: `clearRect`, `fillRect`, `strokeRect`, `beginPath`, `arc`, `fill`, `stroke`, `fillText`, `save`, `restore`, and the properties `fillStyle`, `strokeStyle`, `lineWidth`, `font`, `textAlign`, `textBaseline`, `globalAlpha`.

Create `src/main.js` (browser entry, no exports), `index.html`, `style.css`, `README.md`.

`index.html` must contain these exact substrings (the protected smoke test checks them): `<canvas id="board"`, an element with `id="score"`, an element with `id="best"`, `<script type="module" src="src/main.js"></script>` and `<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">`.

## Behavior
`render`:
1. Fills the whole board (0, 0, cols*cellSize, rows*cellSize) with a dark background using `fillRect`.
2. Draws the food as a filled circle (`arc`) centred in its cell, in a red tone, when `state.food` is not null.
3. Draws every snake segment with one `fillRect` inset by 1px inside its cell; the head (first entry) uses a brighter green than the body.
4. Overlay by status: `'ready'` draws the text "Press an arrow key or Space to start"; `'paused'` draws "Paused"; `'over'` draws "Game over" and "Score: N" and "Press R to restart"; `'won'` draws "You win!" and "Press R to restart". Each overlay first covers the board with a semi-transparent dark `fillRect`, then draws centred text with `fillText`. Status `'playing'` draws no text and no overlay.
5. Total `fillRect` calls for a playing state are at least `snake.length + 1`.

`src/main.js`:
6. On load it creates the state with `createGame({ cols: DEFAULT_COLS, rows: DEFAULT_ROWS })`, sets the canvas `width` and `height` to board size with a cell size of 24px, gets the 2D context from `#board`, and draws.
7. A tick loop built on `setTimeout` calls `step(state)` then redraws, and schedules the next tick after `tickDelayMs(state.score)`. Ticks do nothing visible unless the status is `'playing'`.
8. A `keydown` listener on `document` calls `keyToAction(event.key)`; for `null` or when `ctrlKey`, `metaKey` or `altKey` is held it does nothing and does not call `preventDefault`. Otherwise it calls `event.preventDefault()` and: direction actions call `setDirection`, `pause` calls `togglePause`, `restart` creates a fresh game with `createGame`. It redraws right after handling.
9. After every state change it writes the score to `#score` and the best score to `#best` (as plain numbers via `textContent`). The best score is the maximum score seen, persisted in `localStorage` under the key `snake.best`; all `localStorage` access is wrapped in `try`/`catch` and failures fall back to an in-memory value.
10. When `document.visibilityState` becomes `'hidden'` (the `visibilitychange` event) and the status is `'playing'`, it pauses with `togglePause`.

`index.html` and `style.css`:
11. A centred page with a dark theme, a heading "Snake", a score line with the labels "Score" and "Best", the canvas with a visible border, and a one-line controls hint ("Arrows or WASD to move, Space to pause, R to restart"). Keep the canvas at its natural pixel size.

`README.md`:
12. Documents: what the project is, controls, how to play locally (`npm start` then open http://localhost:8080; opening `index.html` directly via `file://` does not work because browsers block ES module imports), how to run the tests (`npm test`), and the file layout (`src/game.js` logic, `src/input.js` key mapping, `src/render.js` drawing, `src/main.js` wiring).

## Invariants
- No build step, no dependencies, no network requests, no inline scripts in `index.html`.
- `render` is pure with respect to the state: it never mutates `state` and works for `food: null`.
- `src/render.js` must stay importable in Node (no `document` or `window` access at module load).

## Edge cases
- `food` is null (board full, status `'won'`): draw no food and do not throw.
- `localStorage` throws (private mode, blocked storage): the game still works.
- Arrow keys and Space must not scroll the page: they are prevented by rule 8.
- Key auto-repeat produces many `keydown` events; this is fine because `setDirection` ignores duplicates and caps the queue.

## Guardrails
- Do not edit `src/game.js`, `src/input.js`, `package.json` or any file under `test/` (the smoke test is protected).
- Do not call functions from `src/game.js` or `src/input.js` in any Node-run check; they throw until the other task merges.
- Do not add a bundler, framework or service worker.

## Out of scope
- Game rules, key bindings and the speed curve (task T2).
- Touch or swipe controls, sound, themes, difficulty menus, multiple boards.
